name: Acrobat
summary: A lightly armored daredevil who turns mobility training into reliable second chances.

features.name: Expert Acrobat
features.summary: Ignore light-armor check penalties on key mobility skills; while unarmored gain +2 Acrobatics and Fly.

features.name: Second Chance
features.summary: Reroll a failed Acrobatics, Climb, or Fly check at –5 and keep the second result.
features.scaling: one additional daily use every 3 levels
